arxiv-1906-08290.description: Abstract Results are presented from the measurement by ATLAS of long-range ( | Δ ​ η | > 2 |\Delta\eta|>2 ) dihadron angular correlations in s = 8 \sqrt{s}=8 and 13 TeV p ​ p pp collisions containing a Z Z boson. The analysis is performed using 19.

arxiv-2212-08192.title: The KITMUS Test: Evaluating Knowledge Integration from Multiple Sources
arxiv-2212-08192.creator: Akshatha Arodi, Martin Pömsl, Kaheer Suleman, Adam Trischler, Alexandra Olteanu, Jackie Chi Kit Cheung
arxiv-2212-08192.description: Abstract Many state-of-the-art natural language understanding (NLU) models are based on pretrained neural language models. These models often make inferences using information from multiple sources. An important class of such inferences are those that require both background knowledge, presumably contained in a model’s pretrained parameters, and instance-specific information that is supplied at inference time.

arxiv-2302-00864.title: CLIPood: Generalizing CLIP to Out-of-Distributions
arxiv-2302-00864.creator: Yang Shu, Xingzhuo Guo, Jialong Wu, Ximei Wang, Jianmin Wang, Mingsheng Long
arxiv-2302-00864.description: Abstract Out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization, where the model needs to handle distribution shifts from training, is a major challenge of machine learning. Contrastive language-image pre-training (CLIP) models have shown impressive zero-shot ability, but the further adaptation of CLIP on downstream tasks undesirably degrades OOD performances. This paper aims at generalizing CLIP to out-of-distribution test data on downstream tasks.

arxiv-2401-07582.title: Geo-locating Road Objects using Inverse Haversine Formula and NVIDIA DriveWorks
arxiv-2401-07582.creator: Mamoona Birkhez Shami, Gabriel Kiss, Trond Arve Haakonsen, Frank Lindseth
arxiv-2401-07582.description: Abstract Geolocation is integral to the seamless functioning of autonomous vehicles and advanced traffic monitoring infrastructures. This paper introduces a methodology to geolocate road objects using a monocular camera, leveraging the NVIDIA DriveWorks platform. We use the Centimeter Positioning Service (CPOS) and the inverse Haversine formula to geo-locate road objects accurately.

arxiv-2405-00565.title: Leveraging Stack Traces for Spectrum-based Fault Localization in the Absence of Failing Tests
arxiv-2405-00565.creator: Lorena Barreto Simedo Pacheco, An Ran Chen, Jinqiu Yang, Tse-Hsun (Peter) Chen
arxiv-2405-00565.description: Abstract Bug fixing is a crucial task in software maintenance to hold user trust. Although various automated fault localization techniques exist, they often require specific conditions to be effective. For example, Spectrum-Based Fault Localization (SBFL) techniques need at least one failing test to identify bugs, which may not always be available.

arxiv-2405-08671.title: Sequentially Cohen-Macaulay binomial edge ideals
arxiv-2405-08671.creator: Ernesto Lax, Giancarlo Rinaldo, Francesco Romeo
arxiv-2405-08671.description: Abstract . We prove that wheels and block graphs have sequentially Cohen-Macaulay binomial edge ideals. Moreover, we provide a construction of new families of sequentially Cohen-Macaulay graphs by cones. 1991 Mathematics Subject Classification Primary 13C14, 13F70, 05C25, 05C40 Introduction Let G be a simple graph with the vertex set [n] and the edge set E(G) .

arxiv-2410-20244.title: SmartX Intelligent Sec: A Security Framework Based on Machine Learning and eBPF/XDP
arxiv-2410-20244.creator: Talaya Farasat, JongWon Kim, Joachim Posegga
arxiv-2410-20244.description: Abstract . Information and Communication Technologies (ICT) infrastructures are becoming increasingly complex day by day, facing numerous challenges to support the latest networking paradigms. Security is undeniably a critical component for the effective functioning of these advanced ICT infrastructures. By considering the current network security challenges, we propose SmartX Intelligent Sec, an innovative intelligent security framework.

arxiv-2512-05534.title: On the Theoretical Foundation of Sparse Dictionary Learning in Mechanistic Interpretability
arxiv-2512-05534.creator: Yiming Tang, Harshvardhan Saini, Yizhen Liao, Dianbo Liu
arxiv-2512-05534.description: Abstract As AI models achieve remarkable capabilities across diverse domains, understanding what representations they learn and how they process information has become increasingly important for both scientific progress and trustworthy deployment. Recent works in mechanistic interpretability have shown that neural networks represent meaningful concepts as directions in their representation spaces and often encode many concepts in superposition.

pmc-11474892.title: Spatio-temporal distributions of COVID-19 vaccine doses uptake in the Netherlands: a Bayesian ecological modelling analysis
pmc-11474892.creator: Haoyi Wang, Tugce Varol, Thomas Gültzow, Hanne M L Zimmermann, Robert A C Ruiter, Kai J Jonas
pmc-11474892.description: In the transitioning era towards the COVID-19 endemic, there is still a sizable population that has never been vaccinated against COVID-19 in the Netherlands. This study employs Bayesian spatio-temporal modelling to assess the relative chances of COVID-19 vaccination uptake – first, second, and booster doses – both at the municipal and regional (public health services) levels.

pmc-12467877.title: Structure and Function of PML Nuclear Bodies: A Brief Overview of Key Cellular Roles
pmc-12467877.creator: Karolina Dorosz, Lidia Majewska, Jacek Kijowski
pmc-12467877.description: Promyelocytic leukemia nuclear bodies (PML-NBs) are dynamic membrane-less organelles (MLOs) located in the nucleus that serve as regulatory hubs for multiple cellular processes. This review examines current understanding of PML-NB structure, assembly mechanisms, and their diverse functional roles. We discuss how PML-NBs interact with chromatin to influence gene expression, regulate transcription factors, and participate in protein quality control.

pmc-12598924.title: Establishment of a second-generation transgenic marmoset with germline transmission that models polyglutamine disease
pmc-12598924.creator: Eiko N. Minakawa, Kensuke Owari, Naotake Nogami, Terumi Nakatani, Masashi Koizumi, Akiyo Kawanobe, Yosuke Saga, Moeko Kudo, Satoru Noguchi, Takashi Hanakawa, Yuki Hori, Hidemi Numazawa, Toshihide Takeuchi, Yuko Katakai, Ryoichi Saito, Yoshitaka Nagai, Yuko Saito, Ikuo Tomioka, Kazuhiko Seki
pmc-12598924.description: Neurodegenerative diseases, including polyglutamine diseases, remain a clinical challenge, partly because of limited animal models that recapitulate human disease. Here, we describe a second-generation transgenic marmoset model of spinocerebellar ataxia 3 (SCA3), a polyglutamine disease, which stably expresses expanded CAG repeats in ataxin 3 (ATXN3).

pmc-12630909.title: Speciation across depth gradients in reef corals
pmc-12630909.creator: Matías Gómez-Corrales, Ana María González Angel, Bishoy Kamel, Mónica Medina, Nancy Knowlton, Don R. Levitan, Carlos Prada
pmc-12630909.description: Ecological speciation through adaptation to different habitats can readily occur without strong geographic isolation when the same traits underlie both ecological divergence and reproductive isolation. In light-dependent corals with environment-mediated spawning, adaptation to varying light regimes across depths provides opportunities for such speciation. We show that depth-related distributions are common among sister lineages of corals within the photic zone.

pmc-12669734.title: Design, biological evaluation, solvatochromic, DFT, and molecular docking studies of new metal complexes derived from a semicarbazone ligand
pmc-12669734.creator: Magdy A Ibrahim, A Taha, Omima M I Adly, Shery A Fahmy, Maged Abdelaziz, Nesma Salah
pmc-12669734.description: The current study describes the synthesis and characterization of novel Ni(II), Co(II), and Fe(III) complexes of the semicarbazone ligand (ACMHCA). Spectroscopic, conductance, elemental, and magnetic studies confirmed octahedral geometries. Solvatochromic fluorescence analyses, supported by DFT/TD-DFT calculations, revealed higher excited-state dipole moments indicating increased polarity upon excitation. Among the complexes, Co(II)-ACMHCA displayed the highest polarizability and hyperpolarizability, suggesting potential in optoelectronics.

pmc-12735479.title: Role of Probiotics in Enhancing Immune Function and Improving the Effectiveness of Treatments for Pancreatic Cancer
pmc-12735479.creator: Kawaljit Kaur
pmc-12735479.description: Pancreatic cancer often goes unnoticed in its early stages because it causes few or no symptoms, leading to late diagnoses and limited treatment options. The main challenges are delayed detection, drug resistance, and the tumor’s complexity, though progress is being made in targeted therapies, immunotherapy, metabolism-based strategies, and early detection methods.

pmc-12745076.title: Synergistic effects of Lactiplantibacillus plantarum and Acacia mangium leaf tannin extract on the fermentation quality, digestibility, and metabolomic profile of Indigofera silage
pmc-12745076.creator: Farisha Rachma Azzahra, Irwan Susanto, Nahrowi Nahrowi, Rohmatussolihat Rohmatussolihat, Rusli Fidriyanto, Yantyati Widyastuti, Yulianri Rizki Yanza, Vincent Niderkorn, Roni Ridwan, Anuraga Jayanegara
pmc-12745076.description: Background and Aim:Indigofera zollingeriana is a high-protein tropical legume with potential as a sustainable ruminant feed; however, its ensiling is challenged by rapid proteolysis and ammonia accumulation. Incorporating lactic acid bacteria (LAB) inoculants and natural tannin sources may enhance fermentation quality and nitrogen preservation.

pmc-13272128.title: Case Report: Multimodal management of duodenal metastasis from hepatocellular carcinoma complicated by intractable hemorrhage
pmc-13272128.creator: Xin Zhang, Zhongsong Gao, Jiao Wang, Baiguo Xu, Bo Li, Bo Feng, Kefeng Jia
pmc-13272128.description: Hepatocellular carcinoma with duodenal involvement is a rare clinical entity with limited treatment options. Here, we report a case of advanced hepatocellular carcinoma and portal vein tumor thrombus with metastatic involvement of the duodenum that resulted in a recurrent gastrointestinal hemorrhage in a 64-year-old male.

pmc-13449968.title: Effect of carvacrol- and thymol-rich essential oil feed additives on colonization and persistence patterns of Salmonella in broiler chickens☆
pmc-13449968.creator: M. Naeem, S. Manjankattil, S. Poudel, Y. Adhikari, M. Bailey, J. Wang, K. Sulleyman, T. Stokes, W. Mejia, K. Casco, S.J. Rochell, W.J. Pacheco, D.V. Bourassa

pmc-13554594.title: Regions of symmetry in images of natural scenes and artworks
pmc-13554594.creator: Lisa Koßmann, Gonzalo Muradás Odriozola, Johan Wagemans
pmc-13554594.description: While established as an important contributor to shape or pattern “goodness,” mirror symmetry has yet to be extensively studied in complex images more closely resembling our everyday visual surroundings. With this work, we provide insights into symmetry detection and its underlying processes using a novel bounding-box method on 200 images of natural scenes and 200 images of artworks.

pmc-13691134.title: Research note: Improved virus isolation strategies enhance the detection rate for avian leukosis virus eradication in a local chicken breed in China
pmc-13691134.creator: Ruiqiang Geng, Mengyu Song, Wenping Cui, Yixin Wang, Shuang Chang, Zhihao Ren, Peng Zhao
pmc-13691134.description: The detection rate of avian leukosis virus subgroup K (ALV-K) has been increasing annually in Chinese local breeds, its poor replicative capacity limits the success of virus isolation. To improve ALV-K eradication, this study assessed the detection limits of the magnetic-particle chemiluminescent assay and ELISA kits using a standardized virus stock.
